units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 6:1:8">Y. Ber. VI, 10ᵃ</cite> <he>בטלה מָרָתָן</he> their bitter taste is gone.
Ter. VIII, 5 המ׳ the serpent’s discharge.—Esp. gall, bile.
B. Mets. 107ᵇ (ref. to Ex. XXIII, 25) זו מ׳ that means (overflow of) bile, v. חָלָה.—Trnsf. austerity, gravity.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:4:8">Cant. R. to IV, 4</cite> (play on <cite ref="M02663"><he>מֹרִיָּה</he></cite>) <he>שממנו יוצאת מ׳ לעולם</he> (not <he>יוצא</he>) from it austerity (responsibility) went forth to the world.
<cite ref="Ketubot 103b:22">Keth. 103ᵇ</cite> <he>זרוק מ׳ בתלמידים</he> cast bile among the students (be austere against them).

<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 323:9">Sifré Deut. 323</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 32:32">Deut. XXXII, 32</cite> <he>אשכלת מררת</he>) <he>הגדולים שבכם מָרָתָן פרוסה בכם כאשכל</he> as to the great among you, their bile (austere rebuke) is distributed among you as the juice in the grapes; Yalk. ib. 946 <he>מרתן פרוסה בהן וכ׳</he> their bile is distributed within them.
